heading: Time limit on agency consideration of completed applications

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Each Federal banking agency shall take final action on any application to the agency before the end of the 1-year period beginning on the date on which a completed application is received by the agency.

tree.heading: Waiver by applicant authorized
tree.text: Any person submitting an application to a Federal banking agency may waive the applicability of subsection (a) with respect to such application at any time.
